propositions: A plan edited mid-review continues running all remaining LLM passes and fails only at sign time due to material fingerprint mismatch, wasting checkpoint and processing resources.

An own-material change detected at pass seams (verify-inputs or coach-inputs) must cancel the review before recovery paths, returning an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict with finding plan-review-cancelled-stale and exit code 2.
The cancel probe must be scoped to own material only to avoid false cancellations on unrelated ticket writes or related-material drift, preventing regression of d70a.

The cancel mechanism uses a ContextVar-scoped event token checked in _chunk, pass1 funnel, and gate_dispatch, with probes performing lightweight single-ticket reads under local_read_context to avoid fetch/reconverge or sync-lock contention.
A cancelled run must skip floors, attest.sign_plan_review, and sidecar.emit, returning before any attestation or store-revision-advancing write.
Unrelated mid-run writes and related-material drift alone must not trigger cancellation; only own-material fingerprint inequality at a seam probe triggers the cancel path.
